title: Output: validate business process PlanDefinitions
description: A validation report, plus the round-trip counts that make a silently wrong run visible. Constrains the common report schema rather than replacing it.

result.description: This skill may only ever write requires-human. A human ruling is recorded by amending the report, not by producing one that already claims to have it.

roundTrip.description: Reported in both directions, on pass as well as on fail. A run that exits clean with implausible counts is the failure mode these controls exist for, and the counts are what make it visible.

bpmnNodes.description: Activity nodes across all source BPMN files. Gateways and events are out of scope.

orphanNodes.description: BPMN node ids with no corresponding action.

orphanActions.description: Action ids with no corresponding BPMN node. These are the more alarming direction: something was invented.

unresolvedLanes.description: Lane ids whose persona could not be resolved. Flagged, never guessed.

auditEntries.description: Verdicts to append to each artifact's .qa.json sidecar. Supply the verdict only; the writer stamps hashes, timestamp and commit.

criterion.description: Requirement statement key, such as round-trip-complete.
